title: Baseline + Domain 1 intro — IAM audit
topic: IAM policies, SCPs, Organizations, execution vs task role, Fargate, security groups vs NACLs, IAM Identity Center vs RAM
format: 10 timed scenario questions (~16 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces Night 1 IAM audit on deploy user and ECS roles. Answer without night-1-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×3 B×2 C×3 D×2 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: An organization SCP denies s3:DeleteBucket for all accounts. A power-user IAM policy in a member account allows s3:DeleteBucket on arn:aws:s3:::prod-data. Can the power user delete the bucket?

options.A: Yes — IAM Allow in the member account overrides organization SCP defaults
options.B: No — an explicit SCP Deny applies even when IAM allows the action
options.C: Yes — but only if the user assumes a role in the management account
options.D: No — unless the bucket resource policy explicitly allows DeleteBucket

questions.question: A CI/CD pipeline needs ecs:RunTask on a Fargate task definition. Which IAM principal type is the usual GitHub Actions deploy pattern?

options.A: IAM user or role with credentials or OIDC federation from GitHub
options.B: Cognito user pool app client with client credentials grant only
options.C: AWS STS root account access key rotated monthly in Parameter Store
options.D: CloudFront origin access control mapped to the ECS cluster ARN

questions.question: An ECS Fargate task fails with CannotPullContainerError from ECR. The task role has s3:PutObject to the output bucket. What is the first IAM fix?

options.A: Attach AmazonS3FullAccess to the task role for pipeline output writes
options.B: Move the container image to a public Docker Hub repository instead
options.C: Add ECR pull permissions to the task execution role, not the task role
options.D: Enable ECS Exec on the service so the task can pull images interactively

questions.question: A company wants single sign-on for employees into multiple AWS accounts and SaaS apps with centralized permission sets. Which service fits?

options.A: AWS Resource Access Manager sharing subnets across member accounts
options.B: Amazon Cognito user pools with a federated identity provider only
options.C: AWS Organizations consolidated billing without SCPs or permission sets
options.D: AWS IAM Identity Center for workforce SSO and permission sets

questions.question: Traffic to an EC2 instance is blocked even though the instance security group allows inbound TCP 443 from 10.0.0.0/16. The subnet NACL denies inbound TCP 443. What happens?

options.A: Security group Allow wins because it is evaluated after the NACL
options.B: Traffic is blocked — NACL deny applies before the stateful security group
options.C: Only return traffic is blocked; inbound HTTPS still reaches the instance
options.D: The instance security group automatically updates the NACL to match

questions.question: You run aws iam simulate-principal-policy on a Lambda role before deploying a tighter GetSecretValue scope. What does simulate help you verify?

options.A: Whether CloudTrail will log the next API call at delivery time
options.B: Whether AWS Config will mark the role NON_COMPLIANT overnight
options.C: Whether the principal is allowed or denied an action before live use
options.D: Whether KMS will rotate the CMK when the IAM policy changes

questions.question: An ECS Fargate task writes application output to S3. Which role should hold s3:PutObject on the output prefix?

options.A: Task role — application permissions the container code uses at runtime
options.B: Execution role — ECR pull and CloudWatch Logs only, never S3 writes
options.C: CloudFront origin access identity — for static pipeline artifacts only
options.D: GitHub Actions OIDC provider role in the management account only

questions.question: Two AWS accounts need to share a Transit Gateway for hub-and-spoke networking. Which service shares the TGW resource across accounts?

options.A: AWS IAM Identity Center permission sets for workforce SSO access
options.B: Amazon Route 53 private hosted zone association across accounts
options.C: AWS Organizations SCP allowing ec2:AttachTransitGateway only
options.D: AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) for cross-account resource share

questions.question: A security group attached to a Lambda ENI allows outbound TCP 5432 to an Aurora security group. No inbound rules are defined on the Lambda SG. Is that valid?

options.A: Invalid — Lambda requires inbound TCP 443 for CloudWatch Logs delivery
options.B: Invalid — security groups must have symmetric inbound and outbound rules
options.C: Valid — Lambda initiates outbound; nothing needs to call Lambda on a port
options.D: Valid only if the Lambda runs in a public subnet with an internet gateway

questions.question: Which pair best describes the difference between identity policies and resource-based policies on S3?

options.A: Identity policies attach to users/roles; bucket policies attach to the bucket
options.B: Identity policies are optional; bucket policies replace IAM for all S3 access
options.C: Resource policies apply only to DynamoDB; S3 access uses SCPs exclusively
options.D: Both policy types attach to IAM groups and cannot reference external accounts
